svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
the clock starts at 00:00 and moves one minute per letter; its lit lamps are the key, plus one constant
60,480 schedules x 27,852 moves x 12 table rules
move then change: deepest run of checks
lamps lit at each place (last digit)
the move: a clockwise quarter turn of a grid 8 wide; where each known letter is carved
change then move: key needed minus lamps at the message place (last digit); accent where it matches place 22's 9
move then change: minus lamps at the carved place instead; accent where it matches place 22's 11
E of place 22, carved at 71 as Z, needs 14; the 3 lamps there leave 11
other known places agreeing with place 22: 1 change then move, 0 move then change; all 23 must agree
change then move, every schedule and move: 0 full matches, 0 for either crib word alone, and 0 on all ten scrambled coppers
OUT: NO READING; NO CLOCK SCHEDULE FITS EITHER ORDER
